items.name: Docker Engine
items.rationale: Container runtime; keep one container authority.

items.name: npm
items.rationale: Node package manager already in use.

items.name: OpenCode
items.rationale: Canonical coding-agent execution through Session Factory only.

items.name: n8n
items.rationale: Existing internal workflow plane. Sustainable Use License is not OSI OSS; do not embed/resell/host client workflow credentials without license review.
items.license_note: Sustainable Use License; existing dependency, not counted as OSI OSS.

items.name: cloudflared
items.rationale: Tunnel/edge CLI, provider actions remain approval-bound.

items.name: Langfuse
items.rationale: Existing LLM trace/eval integration; avoid parallel LLM observability UI by default.

items.name: PostHog
items.rationale: Product analytics with explicit opt-in controls.

items.name: Black
items.rationale: Existing formatter contract until deliberate Ruff-format migration.

items.name: actionlint
items.rationale: Static and security validation for GitHub workflows.

items.name: age
items.rationale: Small-file encryption primitive for internal artifacts.

items.name: Checkov
items.rationale: IaC policy/security scan; complements, not replaces, repo trust gates.

items.name: direnv
items.rationale: Scoped environment loading; never store secrets in repo.

items.name: DuckDB
items.rationale: Local evidence/data analysis without a second service.

items.name: Grype
items.rationale: Independent vulnerability cross-check; Trivy stays primary.

items.name: just
items.rationale: Canonical developer task facade; no service/scheduler role.

items.name: k6
items.rationale: Controlled API/web load testing against canaries.

items.name: rclone
items.rationale: Portable backup transport; destination authority stays governed.

items.name: restic
items.rationale: Encrypted snapshot backups and restore drills.

items.name: SOPS
items.rationale: Encrypted configuration workflow; no secret values committed.

items.name: Task
items.rationale: Installed for evaluation only; just remains canonical task facade.

items.name: Vale
items.rationale: Docs/content style lint, useful for bilingual governance rules.

items.name: Schemathesis
items.rationale: OpenAPI/GraphQL property/stateful testing on isolated canaries.

items.name: MCP Python SDK v2
items.rationale: MCP v2 lab only until Dealix adapters migrate explicitly.

items.name: PydanticAI
items.rationale: Typed agent experiments; do not create a second company runtime.

items.name: LangGraph
items.rationale: Useful durable graph patterns; Company Machine remains authority.

items.name: DSPy
items.rationale: Offline prompt/program optimization and eval research.

items.name: LiteLLM
items.rationale: Dealix already has a canonical model router; avoid parallel gateway.

items.name: DeepEval
items.rationale: Pytest-like evals; avoid duplicate eval authority until compared.

items.name: Ragas
items.rationale: RAG-specific evals when retrieval workloads justify it.

items.name: Garak
items.rationale: LLM vulnerability probes against isolated test endpoints only.

items.name: PyRIT
items.rationale: Active Microsoft repository; old Azure/PyRIT was archived and moved here. Isolated red-team use only.

items.name: Phoenix
items.rationale: Overlap with Langfuse/OTel; use only if a measured gap appears.
items.license_note: Elastic License 2.0; keep HOLD and do not count as OSI OSS.

items.name: Opik
items.rationale: Overlap with Langfuse/OTel; no second observability authority.

items.name: Grafana Alloy
items.rationale: Candidate collector; current OTel collector remains canonical.

items.name: Prometheus
items.rationale: Metrics backend only if current Sentry/OTel evidence is insufficient.

items.name: Loki
items.rationale: Log backend; pair with Alloy if adopted, not Promtail.

items.name: Tempo
items.rationale: Trace backend when local trace retention is required.

items.name: Grafana
items.rationale: Dashboard UI; do not run until metrics/logs/traces need local UI.

items.name: Qdrant
items.rationale: pgvector is already canonical; avoid parallel vector store.

items.name: Meilisearch
items.rationale: Possible buyer/docs search, not needed for core runtime today.

items.name: Docling
items.rationale: High-value document parsing but heavier footprint; install on demand.

items.name: Crawl4AI
items.rationale: Research crawler for permitted public sources; no relationship inference.

items.name: Firecrawl
items.rationale: Avoid parallel crawling service unless Crawl4AI fails requirements.

items.name: browser-use
items.rationale: Browser-agent research; Playwright remains canonical deterministic browser layer.

items.name: Temporal
items.rationale: Company scheduler already exists; adopt only after proven durability gap.

items.name: Twenty
items.rationale: HubSpot is current CRM mirror; no second CRM.

items.name: Vaultwarden
items.rationale: Possible human secret vault; not a runtime secret authority by default.

items.name: OpenFGA
items.rationale: Fine-grained auth candidate for multi-tenant authorization.

items.name: OPA
items.rationale: Policy engine; Conftest provides immediate file-level use.

items.name: Keycloak
items.rationale: SSO candidate only when customer identity requirements justify service cost.

items.name: dbt Core
items.rationale: Metrics/data models if analytics warehouse emerges.

items.name: Great Expectations
items.rationale: Data quality checkpoints for customer datasets.

items.name: OpenLineage
items.rationale: Lineage standard when multi-pipeline data provenance needs it.

items.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
items.rationale: AutoGen/Semantic Kernel successor; evaluate patterns only, do not replace Company Machine without evidence.

items.name: pip-audit
items.rationale: Python dependency vulnerability audit for release/security receipts.

items.name: pgcli
items.rationale: Human/operator PostgreSQL inspection; no automated production mutation authority.

items.name: Node-RED
items.rationale: Apache-2.0 OSS workflow escape hatch if n8n licensing becomes incompatible; do not run in parallel by default.

items.name: OpenBao
items.rationale: Open-source secrets manager under Linux Foundation/OpenSSF; preferred OSS candidate over BSL Vault.

items.name: Valkey
items.rationale: OSS Redis-compatible server candidate; evaluate before deepening Redis server licensing dependency.

items.name: OpenTofu
items.rationale: OSS IaC option for future provider-neutral infrastructure; current Railway/source contracts remain authority.
